newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Embratel posts higher Jan net vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Embratel posts higher Jan net vs yr ago.

text.p: Brazilian long-distance telephone monopoly Embratel, a unit of the federally owned Telebras, released the following financial results for January 1997.
NOTE: All figures are in Brazilian reais.
The results are calculated under the Brazilian corporate law method and are not inflation-adjusted.
In a statement, Embratel said its January operating profit rose 100.96 percent to 62.1 million reais from 30.9 million reais in the same month last year.

The company, which is slated to be privatized in 1998, also said it had shed 8.6 percent of its workforce by January from a year earlier. Embratel had 10,984 employees in January compared with 12,018 workers a year earlier.
The company's net worth reached 5.28 billion reais in January compared with 5.08 billion reais in the same month of 1996, the statement said.
